Foulwealds are a tribe of hostile corrupted furbolgs who reside in Ashenvale and are viewed as a possible threat by the Horde. Karang Amakkar at Zoram'Gar Outpost feels that a show of force at their home, Greenpaw Village, can remove the threat. Members of the Horde can take on the Foulweald and their leader, Chief Murgut, in the quest King of the Foulweald.
The Four Horsemen are the third and final boss encounter in the Military Quarter in Naxxramas.

Forum trolls are generally people who seek to cause trouble in the Warcraft Community Forums, creating or responding to provocative or nonsensical threads. The term itself is derived from general internet lingo for someone who "trolls" for replies and flame-wars, though within the WoW community there is some confusion due to the prevalence of the Troll humanoid race. Another explanation for the name could be that it was taken from the Troll in Norwegian folklore; a slow, stupid and often rabble-rousing ogre. Recently, the term forum troll has developed into an excuse for using Master Suppression Techniques on opponents in forum disputes. A majority of forum trolls that post use low-level alt

The fox is a small predator that is found in various areas around the Eastern Kingdoms, Pandaria, the Wandering Isle and the Broken Isles. They tend to be clever and cunning. Foxes are a good test of a hunter's skills, and their fluffy tails can be sold for fine profit to boot. Fox tails are as good to hang on a belt to ward off fleas as they are to line the gloves of a fancy noble. During frigid nights in the Storm Peaks, the arctic fox kits use their fluffy tails as a blanket to stay warm. Alpine foxlings burrow deep into snowbanks to hide from predators, and their kits occasionally sneaks bites of food from kills made by much larger animals. FOTM or Flavor of the Month refers to those WoW players who choose a class right after a patch has buffed it, or change class because their previous class is no longer invincible. The FOTM player is most likely your typical Trade chat beggar or anal joke spammer. Example: A FOTM player would roll a warlock, go 0/21/40 (Shadowbolt spam spec), and whine when the next patch drops his dps down to the 5th place. Immediately after he/she would start leveling a BM hunter, in hopes that a noob and easy rotation will bring him/her back to the top. Sadly for our friend, good hunters are scarce and hard to play, and after 3.0.8, level 80 BM hunters became unheard of..

On April Fool's Day 2009, Blizzard added a javascript to their community forums which translated every user's post as if it were done in a very over the top role-playing dramatic style. Posts had "drop caps" added, and several lines of melodramatic description added to their original content. The javascript involved was fairly simple; a set of random generations produced the several pieces of text from a pre-set list. The title "ArrPee" was created inside the javascript, where every time a message was converted it was ran through a function called "arrpee", more specifically "function arrpee(yeoldeposition)".

Fort Triumph was an Alliance military stronghold located in the central Southern Barrens. The fort stands on the eastern side of the Battlescar, and is in constant conflict with the Horde outpost at Desolation Hold across the gorge. Fort Triumph was vital to the Alliance's continued expansion into the Barrens during the Cataclysm, and represented their most fortified presence in the region outside Northwatch Hold. The fort was eventually looted and razed in the lead-up to the Battle of Theramore by a massive Horde army, though recent efforts have been made to re-establish the position.

Forward Command is an Alliance outpost in eastern part of the Fields of Blood in the Southern Barrens under the command of General Hawthorne. When the Horde began their march against the Northwatch Hold, Kalecgos noticed that the command was abandoned, presumably having gone to help Northwatch. Those who survived in Northwatch would eventually regroup in Fort Triumph. Later on, however, Fort Triumph also fell, so it is unknown whether there are any survivors or not.

Forsaken Vanguards are the shock troops of the Forsaken in the battle against the Gilneas Liberation Front. They can be seen in a number of places in Silverpine Forest and, for a time, the Ruins of Gilneas. The first time they appear is in the vicinity of Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas, where they combat the Worgen Rebels in the Northern Headlands. They are only present here until the retreat in Fall Back!, after which a number of their corpses will litter the ground. When Ambermill is taken during Transdimensional Warfare: Chapter III, they are amassed outside the town, ready to descend upon it. Many of their corpses are present in Pyrewood Village by the time Lord Godfrey

Forsaken Sharpshooters can be found in the vicinity of the Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas during the phasing of that area for the Silverpine Forest storyline. They will shoot and, when necessary, engage in melee combat with the attacking members of the Gilneas Liberation Front. After the phasing, they disappear.

Forward Commander Onslaught is a quest giver located at Forsaken Forward Command during the phasing of that area as part of the Silverpine Forest storyline. Onslaught initially has the player retrieve the Forsaken Communication Device (F.C.D.), and thereafter communicates via auto-quest, which is achieved through a buff rather than a physical item in the player's inventory. He instructs the player as they conduct various covert operations against the forces of Gilneas. However, the situation worsens as the story progresses, and it is eventually discovered that the forces of the 7th Legion have amassed in preparation for an assault on the Forsaken camp. Four Senses Brew was created by the enigmatic blind Brewfather, Ren Yun. It is the "one brew" that appeals to the sense of smell, taste, touch, and hearing at the same time. He was only able to perfect it at the end of his long life, and it was considered the most magnificent discovery of his generation. General knowledge says that the recipe was lost to time, because Ren Yun's handwriting was pretty much illegible. However, someone apparently had the good sense to ask Ren Yun if they could transcribe it for him instead, as there is one legible copy in the form of a tablet that has survived to the modern era. Now, all someone has to do is to find it...

Fort Wrynn is the main Alliance base in Talador, located in the northeastern part of the region, north of Vol'jin's Pride. The only major building in this outpost is decided by the commander, which is either Wrynn Artillery Tower or an Arcane Sanctum. Before a choice is made, the space is occupied by Fort Wrynn Worksite. There is a command table in these buildings for completing and starting new garrison missions. The units of the Fort Wrynn garrison were first encountered when they assisted the draenei to fight the orcs that invaded Karabor.

The Fort Victory Laborer is a human located at Fort Victory in Nazmir.
Fort Victory Huntresses are night elves located at Fort Victory in Nazmir.
Fort Victory Footmen are humans located at Fort Victory in Nazmir. Several are found dead at the Fall.
The Found Sack of Gems drops once Boon of the Gemfinder is applied.

__NOTOC__ Fort Daelin is a in western Stormsong Valley, named after Daelin Proudmoore and home to the Proudmoore Battalion. It was under siege by the naga, with brutes pummeling the stone walls as harpoons drove further into the walls.
Fortitude of the Ebon Blade is a Blood death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Carrion Feast trait.

Foul-Smelling Samples are contained in Stinky Potions and Pots of Viscous Goop in Stormsong Valley or it also drop from the following mobs: *Briarback Geomancer *Briarback Lookout *Briarback Packmaster *Briarback Warcaller *Hulking Kraulguard
Four Winds Traders are two pandaren sitting by a campfire in the Path of a Hundred Steps in the Veiled Stair.
__NOTOC__ Fort Victory was an Alliance outpost in Nazmir during the Fourth War. After the armistice with the Horde was signed at the end of the war, the Alliance ceded control of the encampment.
The Fort Daelin Handaxe is a quest reward from From the Depths.

The Forward Camp is a small Devoted sethrak camp directly northeast of the Terrace of the Devoted in Vol'dun. Some of the Devoted from the terrace tried to get ahead of the Faithless siege by attacking the Faithless' nearby Temple Incursion in the dead of night. However, the Faithless knew that they were coming, and many of the defenders were captured. During Faction Assaults on Vol'dun, a portion of the camp becomes a battlefield between the Horde and the Alliance from which Lasan Skyhorn sends Aviash and the Horde adventurer to the Alliance Airship.
Foul Dreadbringers are doomguard located in Illidari Stand in Azsuna during Legion Assaults.

The Four Stingers are a cluster of large rock formations just east of Dead Man's Pass in western Vol'dun. The vulpera Rikati lives here, harvesting the "honey" (venom) from the bilewing wasps that live among the outcroppings.
Fortified is the base affix for Mythic+. This affix or Tyrannical (affix) will be applied as the first affix for any Mythic+ dungeon.
Fossil-Finder 3000 is provided as an objective for The Fossil-Finder 3000. It is used to locate the Suspicious Mound of Dirt in Un'Goro Crater.
Forward Lookouts are humans located in the Arathi Highlands. They are also present during the Battle for Stromgarde.
The Foul Shadowsleet Slippers drop from Domina in the Pool of Ask'ar in Blackfathom Deeps.
Forsaken Stablehands are Forsaken located in the Stables of Arathi Basin.
Fossil Oils were to drop from Felblood Horrors and Blistering Rots in Hellfire Peninsula.
Forsaken Soldiers are Forsaken accompanying Captain Asther in Gilneas. They were killed by Koroth the Hillbreaker.
The Forsaken Trooper Armguards are a quest reward from Ace in the Hole.
The Fortified Librarian's Grips are a quest reward from Hit the Books.
Forsaken Researchers are Forsaken located in the Forward Guard in Zuldazar.

Fortune's Fist is a frigate used as a shipping freighter located in the Forbidding Sea off the northern Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows. The ship has been seized by gilgoblins, and many of the former crewmembers can be found dead in the waters between the vessel and the shore. The survivors have holed up in a camp in the Sorrowmurk. The Landward Cannon is found here and allows safe passage back to land... most of the time. The Thousand-Thread-Count Fuse can be found on deck, while the Extra-Pure Blasting Powder is found in the captain's quarters. Finally, the Stack of Questionable Publications is hidden away in the ship's hold.
__NOTOC__ Foundry Guardians are humans, dwarves, and worgen located in and around Ashvane Foundry in Tiragarde Sound during Faction Assaults.
__NOTOC__ Foundry Medics are humans, draenei, and Lightforged draenei located in Ashvane Foundry in Tiragarde Sound during Faction Assaults.
Foundry Escorts are gnomes located in Ashvane Foundry in Tiragarde Sound during Faction Assaults.
__NOTOC__ Foundry Commanders are humans and night elves located in Ashvane Foundry in Tiragarde Sound during Faction Assaults.

The Forsworn, also known as the Dark Kyrian, are Kyrian Aspirants that failed to complete a rite of passage. These once-bright aspirants darken and become lost, wandering the plains of Bastion to lament. Containing the Forsworn is the key, for if left unchecked, doubt can spread like a disease.
Foul Larvae are caterpillars located in the Precipice of Oblivion and Forgotten Cove in Stormsong Valley.
Foul Totems are totems summoned by Fel Seers, Fel Cannoneers, and Council Felcaller in Talador.
The Foxhollow Falconer's Bracers drop from the Foxhollow Skyterror in Foxhollow Woods in Tiragarde Sound.
Foul-Smelling Flasks drop from the following quilboar in Stormsong Valley: *Briarback Geomancer *Briarback Lookout *Briarback Packmaster *Briarback Warcaller *Hulking Kraulguard
Foul Observers are eye stalks located in the Akhenet Fields in Uldum.
The Fort Daelin Lantern is a quest reward from Piercing the Shield.

Fort Victory Sausage is sold by the following Alliance innkeepers on Zandalar: *Caregiver Mila *Corgon Gumsprocket *Eryssa Riversong *Falloughue the Hospitable *Glaston *Priestess Emirrin *Priestess Islara
Fort Daelin Speargun is a quest reward from From the Depths.

Forsworn Investigators are Forsworn kyrian located at the Walk of Recollection in Bastion.
Forsworn Researchers are Forsworn kyrian located at the Walk of Recollection and Vault of the Archon in Bastion.

Forsworn Appraisers are stewards located at Kalliope's Rest in Bastion.
Forsworn Vandals are Forsworn kyrian located at Kalliope's Rest in Bastion.
Forsworn Looters are Forsworn kyrian located at Kalliope's Rest in Bastion.
Foul-Tongue Cyrlix is a Maldraxxi necromancer located in the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus.
Forsaken Surgeon is a Forsaken located in the Screaming Pit in Stormsong Valley. He walks around War Gore and cheers at it.
